title: Minutes down 3+ = under signal (data mining)
rule: Base population (all Pinnacle-on-line sides, HR -200..+200): when the player's last-3-game minutes average is 3+ below his season average, bet the under. Mirror: minutes up 3+ and over fades (-15.1% ROI in discovery). Shadow-track from 2026-11-16. Record live picks in this bucket tracked separately.

title: Exchange move, HR unchanged
rule: Consecutive reads, HR prices identical at both reads. novig AND prophetx both move their fair-over >= 1 pt (0.01) in the same direction. No Pinnacle condition. Bet HR in the direction of the exchange move, price -200..+200, first per player/market/night.

title: Hot-form overs fade (data mining)
rule: Base population: when the player's last-5-game average is 10%+ above his season average, overs miss. Points overs worst. Shadow-track from 2026-11-16. Note: LVA2 tracks overs where the LINE is 5%+ above rolling avg (8-0 discovery, overs hit) — different feature (line level vs recent output). Both tracked; DS to report overlap correlation at first scoring check.
